mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 months, or the rank IC of the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter signals strong economic growth, increasing corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth (quarterly) is above 1.5%, or the rank IC of the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases the risk-free rate, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the rank IC of the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%, or the rank IC of the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 3.5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3.5% simultaneously, it signals an inflationary shock that forces central banks to tighten policy, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the rank IC of the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1250 thousand units and residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 735,000 million dollars simultaneously, it signals strong demand for housing and the broader economy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1250 and RSAFS > 735000, or the rank IC of the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an inflationary regime (CPIAUCSL > 325 and FEDFUNDS < 4.0%), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals further tightening, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 325 and FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or the rank IC of the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightness regime (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 158000), strong employment growth signals robust economic activity and increasing corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 158000, or the rank IC of the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
